description: This file is a shell script used for performance testing and configuration of the 'fsmonitor' feature in a Git project. It sets up various testing scenarios to measure the impact of the 'fsmonitor' feature, manages hooks, and runs different configurations, including with and without the feature enabled, and with different providers like Watchman or a built-in daemon.

methods.name: trace_start
methods.description: Initializes trace logging for a test, setting up directories and exporting trace variables if tracing is enabled.

methods.name: trace_stop
methods.description: Stops trace logging by unsetting related environment variables.

methods.name: touch_files
methods.description: Creates a specified number of empty files in a directory named after the number.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Runs a series of commands expecting them to succeed, used for setting up tests.

methods.name: setup_for_fsmonitor_hook
methods.description: Sets up the Git core.fsmonitor hook script depending on environment variables and available tools.

methods.name: test_perf_w_drop_caches
methods.description: Runs performance tests, dropping caches if specified via environment variables.

methods.name: test_fsmonitor_suite
methods.description: Runs a sequence of performance tests under different configurations of the fsmonitor feature.
